basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and Sims enthusiast from Seattle, WA. I work as a digital marketing specialist during the day and spend my evenings unwinding with simulation games. I'm passionate about finding and sharing game strategies. I'm happily married, no kids yet, but two adorable cats keep us entertained. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings and late weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in digital marketing, which I studied at the University of Washington. My expertise in gaming comes from years of playing and engaging with online communities. I love learning about new game mechanics and sharing tips with fellow gamers.
